title: HL7 v2 or FHIR message view
description: An interface analyst's view of one message: the raw text (HL7 v2 segments or a FHIR JSON resource) and a decoded table of the fields that matter. The raw text must be syntactically valid and each decoded value must equal the value in the raw text. Patients are synthetic.

format.description: hl7v2: pipe-delimited segments, one per line (MSH first). fhir: one FHIR resource as JSON.

examples: Message detail — ORU^R01 from the laboratory feed

source.description: Where the message was captured (feed name and queue state).

raw.description: The message exactly as transmitted. HL7 v2: segments separated by newlines, starting MSH|^~\&|. FHIR: pretty-printed JSON with resourceType and id.

decoded.description: Decoded fields (up to 14). For HL7 v2 use SEG-n (PID-5); for FHIR use a dotted path (subject.reference). Each value equals the raw value.

note.description: An analyst's note under the table, such as why the message was rejected.
examples: Rejected: receiving system has no patient with this identifier.
